policies.title: Bahamian ordinary passports: Grenada visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy nationality schedule lists the Bahamas as requiring no visitor visa.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Bahamian passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The actively linked schedule was updated April 2024 and should be rechecked if Grenada publishes a replacement.
Work, study, residence, transit, crew, diplomatic, official, service and special-document routes are outside this classification.

policies.title: Bahamian ordinary passports: Panama visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule expressly places the Bahamas in its no-visa visitor cohort for stays up to three months.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Bahamian passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The Embassy's named no-visa cohort states a maximum tourist stay of three months.
Work, residence, transit, special documents, final admission and separate third-country-document waiver rules remain outside scope.

policies.title: Bahamian ordinary passports: Jordan advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Jordan's live official nationality table marks the Bahamas ineligible for arrival issuance and directs visitors to obtain an embassy visa before arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Bahamian passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The Tourism Board table directs travelers to contact the nearest Jordanian Embassy and obtain a visa before arrival.
Work, residence, transit, special documents, carrier checks, border-crossing limits and final admission remain outside scope.

application.label: Jordan Tourism Board visa requirements
steps: Contact the competent Jordanian Embassy before travel.
Obtain the visitor visa before departure and carry the required supporting documents.

policies.title: Bahamian ordinary passports: Turkiye electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Turkiye's current Foreign Ministry schedule says ordinary Bahamian passport holders need a visa and can obtain a three-month multiple-entry eVisa.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Bahamian passport holder travelling for tourism or commerce.
The Foreign Ministry says the electronic visa is a three-month multiple-entry document; the issued document and its conditions must be checked before departure.
Work, study, residence, transit treatment, official passports, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

application.label: Official Turkiye eVisa application
steps: Enter the Bahamian ordinary-passport and intended-travel details on the official eVisa service.
Complete the required application and payment, then download the issued eVisa before travel.

conflicts.explanation: The fallback says visa on arrival, while Jordan's current official nationality table marks the Bahamas not applicable for arrival issuance and requires an embassy visa before arrival.
The fallback says visa on arrival, while Turkiye's current Foreign Ministry schedule directly provides electronic rather than border issuance for ordinary Bahamian passport holders.
